label: liftsUnderABlendedCover: a layer under a visible multiply layer lifts, so the drag draws the cover as a plain over
liftsBlended: a multiply layer lifts and the compositor draws it as a plain over
placementIgnoresBoxOrigin: the lifted pixels sit at the layer's corner, not the box's
find: (m.tx, m.ty) = (m.tx + m.a * x + m.c * y, m.ty + m.b * x + m.d * y)

label: baseKeepsLayer: the picture under the lift still has the layer, so the drag shows it twice
find: for above in 0...at where !base.layers[above].kind.isAdjustment { base.layers[above].isVisible = false }
replace: for above in 0..<at where !base.layers[above].kind.isAdjustment { base.layers[above].isVisible = false }

label: liftBaseLosesRest: the picture under a selection's lift hides the whole layer, so its rest vanishes mid-drag (#5813)
liftsAloneOverRest: a selection's lift skips the picture under it, so the rest of the layer vanishes mid-drag (#5813)
find: part == PixelRect(x: 0, y: 0, width: tiles.width, height: tiles.height)

label: coverRefused: a layer under a visible plain layer stays down, so its drag resamples on the CPU every sample (#6259)
baseKeepsCover: the picture under the lift keeps the layers above, so the cover shows twice mid-drag
find: for above in 0...at where !base.layers[above].kind.isAdjustment { base.layers[above].isVisible = false }

label: spriteUntoned: the lifted pixels skip the image's adjustments, so the layer flashes untoned mid-drag
marginUnplaced: a blurred lift ignores its margin, so it sits margin pixels off the layer mid-drag
toneLayersSkipped: the adjustment layers above skip the lifted pixels, so the layer flashes untoned mid-drag
baseDropsTone: the picture under the lift hides the adjustment layers above, so it shows untoned mid-drag
find: for above in 0...at where !base.layers[above].kind.isAdjustment { base.layers[above].isVisible = false }

label: maskedToneStaysDown: a masked adjustment layer above keeps the layer down, though the canvas tones through no adjustment mask
styleStaysDown: a styled layer keeps off the compositor and resamples each drag step, though the canvas draws no style
marginSkipsBlurLayers: the lift carries only the image's margin, so a Blur layer above clips the soft edge
